questions.question: Where did God tell Jonah to go, and where did he flee instead?
options: To Edom; instead he went to Jerusalem
To Tyre; he went to Egypt
To Nineveh; he fled toward Tarshish
questions.answer: To Nineveh; he fled toward Tarshish
